verdict.rationale: LocalAI's OpenAI-compatible API loads models on demand per request (model name specified per call) and supports preloading multiple models via PRELOAD_MODELS, plus gallery install/list commands and model aliasing, implying multi-model serving without restart. However, there is no explicit documentation describing hot-swapping between already-loaded models at runtime, concurrent multi-model memory management, or an endpoint to unload/switch active models without a restart. missing for 10: explicit docs on dynamic model switching/unloading at runtime, concurrency/multi-model memory handling, and independent hands-on confirmation of no-restart switching.
